subject: System
action: WHEN `submitCreateWork` runs, it must call `createClient` and `supabase.auth.getUser`; IF no user is found, it must return the login-required error instead of creating the work.
condition: The submission flow has no authenticated user.
expectedOutcome: The create-work operation does not proceed for an unauthenticated requester.

subject: System
action: WHILE the create-work submission is pending, the `새 작품 만들기` button must remain disabled.
expectedOutcome: The screen blocks duplicate submits during the in-flight create request.

subject: System
action: IF `createWork` returns failure, the screen must show a visible destructive error message inline above the form using the returned error, or `작품을 만들지 못했어요.` when no specific error is available.
expectedOutcome: The user sees inline feedback that the work was not created.

subject: System
action: WHEN the user clicks `새 작품 만들기`, the screen must call `submitCreateWork` with `title`, `trimmed-or-null synopsis`, and `genre`.
condition: The user submits the create-work form.
expectedOutcome: Whitespace-only synopsis is sent as `null`, and genre may remain unselected.

subject: System
action: WHEN `createWork` succeeds, the screen must navigate to `/studio/{workId}`.
expectedOutcome: The user is redirected to the newly created work page.

subject: System
action: WHILE `title.trim()` is empty, the screen must keep the `새 작품 만들기` submit button disabled.
condition: `title.trim()` is empty on the create-work form.
expectedOutcome: The user cannot submit the create-work request from this screen.

subject: authenticated user
action: Create a new work with a required title and optional synopsis and genre.
